author: Stunning Couches LLC
description: MCP server (stdio) for Underdog API: Underdog Fantasy pick'em lines, Higher/Lower multipliers, line history and graded results as tools.
name: Underdog API

tools.name: demo_board
tools.description: Fictional Underdog-style board in the live response shape. No key needed; use it to learn the schema.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

tools.name: demo_changes
tools.description: Fictional change events in the live shape. No key needed.

tools.name: credit_costs
tools.description: The credit policy, or the credits one request path would cost (path, for example /api/v1/projections?limit=200). No key needed.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Leagues and stats on the board now, and the first recorded date per league. Call first.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Current Underdog Fantasy pick'em lines with separate Higher and Lower payout multipliers per side.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Each current line with its Higher and Lower side as odds entries. 5 minutes behind on the free plan.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Recorded change events (line.moved, multiplier changes, suspensions, closes) across the board.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

tools.name: get_line_history
tools.description: Every recorded change of one market, from get_board ids (udm_...).

tools.name: get_board_as_of
tools.description: The board as it stood at a past instant (as_of ISO timestamp). Free reads the last 24 hours.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Graded lines: Higher, Lower or void against the final box score. Paid plans; Free answers with a labelled sample.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

tools.name: get_hit_rates
tools.description: How often one player went Higher or Lower over recent graded games. Paid plans.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

tools.name: get_multipliers
tools.description: Payout multipliers per side on the current board.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

tools.name: get_payouts
tools.description: Standard, Flex and Streaks payout reference tables.

tools.name: get_training_set
tools.description: One labelled row per graded line for model training. Paid plans.

league.description: League code from get_coverage, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, CBB, CFB, TENNIS, CS

cursor.description: meta.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters
